purpose: Closed-question Grand Goal bank. At generate time, pick one card for the player's wiki language. Victory is still landing on answer_title; the question is what the client shows instead of the title.
rule: top 100 overall ∪ top 10 per pool tag

card_fields.qid: Wikidata id. Stable across languages; preferred lookup key.
card_fields.answer_title: Exact Wikipedia title on this language wiki (the Victory page).
card_fields.answer_url: Convenience link; do not use as an id.
card_fields.question: Closed question in this wiki's language. Must not name the answer.
card_fields.lead_fact: The lead detail the question was built from (authoring / review).
card_fields.lead: Truncated plain-text Wikipedia lead at bank-build time.
card_fields.question_en: English source question when this QID is also in the EN bank.
card_fields.tags: Pool tags from pool_{lang}.json (noisy; do not treat as ground truth).
card_fields.via: Why the page is in the bank: 'overall' and/or pool tag names.
card_fields.overall_rank: 1–100 if this page is in the usable top 100; else null.
card_fields.category_ranks: Rank within each tag's usable top 10 that selected it.
card_fields.sensitive: Copied from the pool; bank selection already drops sensitive pages.

usage.pick: Filter cards where question is non-empty and status is not rejected.
usage.victory: Compare the landed page title to answer_title (after redirects).
usage.cross_lang: Join on qid when the same entity exists in several banks.
